messages:
Tom (CS): forwarding from Sam at Acme — they started hitting 429s on /v1/rerank around 09:30 UTC. impact: production traffic degraded (some requests retrying, increased latency). sample payload and headers below.

Maria (Support): can you paste the request & response headers + retry-after if present? also customer account id so we can check quota.

Tom (CS): sure — acct: acct_acme_42. payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "user_id": "user-123",
  "candidates": [ /* 500 items */ ],
  "query": "rank these by relevance"
}
```
response (snippet):
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "message": "Request quota exceeded for rerank endpoint"
  }
}
```
headers: `x-rate-limit-limit: 1000`, `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `retry-after: 12`

rate-limit-bot: detected surge from acct_acme_42: rerank QPS 420 (5m rolling), previous baseline ~18 QPS. candidate-multiplier observed (avg candidates/request = 480).

Jia (SRE): looking at infra — this is classic candidate-count amplification. each rerank request multiplies internal scoring work by #candidates; our limiter counts scoring ops, not just API calls. with ~480 candidates, their effective scoring ops = QPS * 480. at peak that maps to ~200k scoring ops/s which triggered the shared rate limiter. logs: `rerank.score.ops` metric spiked along with per-region limiter drops.

Oliver (ML Eng): confirming — rerank scoring is O(n) per candidate and we account for it in throttle. large candidate lists (>>100) will blow past typical QPS quotas. also noticed many requests had `candidates` unsorted/duplicative which wastes cycles.

Maria (Support): immediate customer guidance: 1) reduce candidates per request to <= 50, 2) paginate results (send multiple smaller rerank calls), 3) implement exponential backoff on 429 (Retry-After header respected). I'll DM Sam these steps.

Tom (CS): Sam — can you try sending a reduced candidate set (50) and confirm? we can also temporarily increase quota while you change code.

Sam (Acme): thanks, trying now. switched to 50 candidates and sent a small load test — no 429s so far. will run longer test.

Jia (SRE): operational mitigation options: we can grant a short-term soft quota bump for acct_acme_42 ( +3x scoring-ops allowance for 2 hours ) to buy time for client fixes. need approval from product on quota change and ops execs to avoid noisy neighbor. I can apply it if granted. monitoring: will watch `x-rate-limit-remaining` and `rerank.score.ops`.

Oliver (ML Eng): additional note for docs/SDK: we should add a warning about candidate list size and provide helper to dedupe/prioritize candidates client-side before calling rerank. opening a doc issue.

Maria (Support): logging next steps for the customer: - guide: reduce candidate list and backoff - offer quota bump for 2 hours - follow up in 24h to ensure no regression. Sam, do you want the quota bump?

Sam (Acme): yes please for 2 hours while we deploy the fix. 

Tom (CS): I'll request the temporary bump now. Jia — watch for the change and confirm when applied.

Jia (SRE): applied soft bump at 09:55 UTC for acct_acme_42 (+3x scoring ops) — monitoring dashboards green, no further 429s observed in last 5m. keeping alerts on.

Maria (Support): closing loop with Sam and will follow up tomorrow. internal actions: Oliver to add doc warning + SDK helper; Jia to add a clearer alert mapping for rerank scoring-op spikes; Tom to confirm customer deploy.

Tom (CS): thanks all — keeping thread open until Sam confirms the fix is live. :thumbsup:
